verdict.rationale: The firm's Employment & Pensions page lists 'structuring of compensation and benefits', and it publishes a detailed ESOP tax analysis of an ITAT ruling on a stock-option buyback. Together these show Indian ESOP-related expertise on its own pages, but no page explicitly describes designing option plans or employee equity programs as a service. Missing for 10: an explicit service description of designing ESOP or option plans, coverage of plan drafting, vesting and administration, any mention of cross-border schemes such as UK EMI or German VSOP, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm designs employee equity programs — option plans and local schemes like UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOPs — described on its own pages

citations.quote: The Tribunal further held that a vested stock option represents a right to subscribe to shares, which constitutes a capital asset within the meaning of section 2(14) of the ITA
Repurchase of Stock Options: Perquisite v/s Capital Gains
